blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
As LLMs take up the role of authoring charts using visualization DSLs, the human constraints that shaped those languages may no longer apply—-what is easy for a person is not necessarily easy for a model.
To understand how LLMs might work better with DSLs, we explore where and how they fail with current DSL designs.
We evaluate 10 JSON-style visualization DSLs with 41 tasks across 3 LLMs, then assess the generated specifications with JSON and rendering checks, and qualitative coding of failed cases.
Analyzing how this specification generation process fails,
we identify four recurring failure patterns, link each to specific DSL features, and discuss design considerations for future DSL designs.
blocks.zh:
由于LLMs承担了使用可视化DSL来编写图表的角色,塑造这些语言的人的制约因素可能不再适用——对于一个模型来说,对一个人来说,什么容易就不一定容易。
为了了解LLMS如何更好地与DSL工作,我们探索它们在哪里以及如何在当前的DSL设计上失败.
我们评估了10个JSON风格的可视化DSL,在3个LLM中执行41个任务,然后用JSON来评估生成的规格和渲染检查,以及失败案例的质量编码.
分析这个规格生成过程是如何失败的,
我们找出四个反复出现的故障模式, 将每个与特定的DSL特性联系起来, 并讨论未来DSL设计的设计考虑。

blocks.en:
This study (left, middle) explores the patterns (right) that occur across DSL usage of visualization DSLs.
The patterns we observe show how mismatches between model assumptions and DSL conventions can result in LLMs producing invalid or incorrect visualizations—highlighting areas for future DSL design consideration.
blocks.zh:
本研究(左,中)探索了在DSL使用可视化DSL时发生的模式(右).
我们观察到的规律显示模型假设和DSL常规之间的不匹配会如何导致LLMs产生无效或不正确的可视化——为将来DSL设计考虑的突出区域.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
LLM-based agents are increasingly being tasked to translate natural-language requests into chart specifications [ 7 , 41 ] , shifting the human role from coding to specifying intent and inspecting output. Chart generation through DSLs is already embedded in diverse workflows—from interactive tools that delegate specification writing to AI [ 40 ] to programmatic toolkits that emit specifications for downstream applications [ 25 , 50 , 23 ] —where users increasingly inspect the rendered chart rather than the specification behind it. This shift challenges a fundamental assumption behind many visualization domain-specific languages (DSLs) and authoring tools: that the author is human.
Concise syntax, towers of defaults [ 44 ] , and hierarchical structure have long been designed [ 35 ] around cognitive dimensions [ 11 ] such as memory, attention, and effort.
When the author is a language model, those trade-offs may change as
what is easy for a human may be difficult for a model.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的基于LLM的代理人被赋予将自然语言请求转化为图表规格[7,41]的任务,将人类角色从编码转向明确意图并检查产出. 通过DSL生成图表已经嵌入了多种工作流程中——从将规格书写授权给AI[40]的交互式工具,到向下游应用发布规格[25,50,23]的程序工具包——用户越来越多地检查所提供的图表而不是其背后的规格. 这一转变挑战了许多可视化域特有语言(DSLs)和作者工具背后的基本假设:作者是人.
简明的语法,默认的塔[44],分级结构早已被设计出[35]围绕认知维度[11],如记忆,注意力,和努力.
当作者是一个语言模型时,这些取舍可能会改变为:
对于一个模型来说,对于一个人类来说,什么是容易的可能是困难的。

blocks.en:
As a first step in understanding how language designs might shift,
this paper studies how LLMs fail when authoring JSON-style visualization DSLs.
We compare 10 DSLs across 41 visualization tasks, covering common authoring patterns such as single charts, layered views, facets, and composite charts.
We focus on JSON-style DSLs because they are widely used in declarative visualization grammars [ 35 , 19 ] and share enough surface structure to make cross-DSL failure comparison meaningful.
blocks.zh:
作为理解语言设计如何转变的第一步,
本文研究了LLMs在作者JSON风格可视化DSL时如何失败.
我们比较了涉及41个可视化任务的10个DSL, 包括了常见的编写模式,如单图,分层视图,侧面,和复合图.
我们专注于JSON风格的DSL,因为它们被广泛用于宣示可视化语法[35,19],并共享足够的表面结构,使交叉DSL故障比较具有意义.

blocks.en: Across 1230 trials (1223 generated specifications) from three LLMs, we identify four recurring failure patterns. In encoding mismatch , models select the intended data field but place it in an incorrect position. In layout arithmetic failure , they fail to coordinate the many small spatial decisions needed for titles, legends, axes, and panels. In missed renderer defaults , they omit settings whose default behavior changes the chart. In failed workaround , they approximate unsupported chart types with nearby primitives or custom-built compositions that do not preserve the requested semantics.
blocks.zh: 在3个有限责任公司进行的1230起试验(1223起生成规格)中,我们确定了4起反复发生的故障模式。 在编码不匹配时,模型会选择预定的数据字段,但将其置于错误的位置. 在布局算术失败中,它们未能协调标题、传说、轴和面板所需的许多小空间决定。 在缺失的渲染器默认情况下,它们会省略默认行为改变图表的设置. 在失败的操作中,它们将不支持的图表类型与附近的原始或自定义的不保存所要求语义的构件相近。

blocks.en:
These failures are not random syntax mistakes—they repeatedly trace back to DSL design choices. Based on these findings, we identify several design considerations for visualization DSLs that may work better with models. We suggest that (1) DSLs should expose common visual encodings as explicit fields or channels rather than requiring placement inside nested containers; (2) DSLs should let composition primitives own ordinary layout budgeting instead of dispersing numeric controls across titles, legends, axes, and panels; and (3) DSLs should make renderer defaults and hidden contracts visible at authoring time.
AI-native visualization DSL design is not simply about shorter syntax or broader permissiveness, but about representing visual intent in forms whose structure and semantics LLMs can reliably interpret and compose.
blocks.zh:
这些失败不是随机的语法错误——它们反复地追溯到DSL设计选择. 基于这些发现,我们确定了可视化DSL的几个设计考虑,这些考虑与模型可能更好. 我们建议,(1)DSL应把常见的视觉编码暴露为明确的字段或通道,而不是要求放置在被嵌入的容器内;(2)DSL应让成分原始人拥有普通的布局预算编制,而不应将数字控制分散在标题,传说,轴和面板之间;(3)DSL应使渲染器默认和隐藏的合同在作者时可见.
AI-inative可视化DSL设计不仅仅是关于更短的语法或更广泛的可容性,而是关于用其结构和语义LLM能够可靠地解释和作曲的形式来表示视觉意图.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work builds upon prior studies of visualization DSLs, as well as works exploring the interaction between LLMs and visualizations.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作借鉴了以前对可视化DSL的研究,以及探索LLMs和可视化之间的相互作用的作品.

blocks.en:
Visualization DSLs .
The Grammar of Graphics (GoG) tradition [ 45 , 44 ] inspired a range of visualization grammars or languages , from Polaris [ 38 ] and its successor VizQL [ 13 ] —the language behind Tableau, which compiles one declarative description into both database queries and graphics— to JSON-based specifications [ 36 , 35 , 19 ] . VizQL is neither JSON-based nor publicly available as a standalone runtime, so it falls outside our test suite. These include libraries and languages for general statistic charting [ 28 , 14 , 3 , 46 ] , as well as more specialized systems for animation [ 16 , 10 ] or annotation [ 30 , 6 ] . Most recently, Flint [ 43 ] introduced a semantics-driven intermediate language for both human authors and AI agents that compiles concise, library-agnostic specifications to multiple visualization backends. McNutt [ 24 ] surveyed those DSLs specifically centered in data serialization formats (like JSON), highlighting variations in specification structure (formal vs. colloquial), layout primitives, and chart-type vocabularies.
Existing evaluations have targeted human authoring trade-offs [ 34 , 29 ] or quantitative design-pattern differences [ 17 ] ; we instead probe how LLMs generate these DSLs, with consideration of the languages themselves.
blocks.zh:
可视化DSLs.
Gographics(Gog)传统[45,44]启发了一系列可视化语法或语言,从Polaris[38]及其后继者VizQL[13]——Tableau背后的语言,将一个声明性描述汇编到数据库查询和图形——到基于JSON的规格[36,35,19]. VizQL既不基于JSON,也不公开作为独立的运行时间,所以它不属于我们的测试套间. 其中包括图书馆和通用统计图表的语文[28、14、3、46],以及更专门的动画系统[16、10]或注释[30、6]。 最近,弗林特[43]为人类作者和AI代理都引入了由语义驱动的中间语言,将简洁,库-不可知的规格汇编成多个可视化后端. McNutt [24] 调查了那些专门以数据序列化格式为中心(如JSON)的DSL,突出了规格结构的变化(形式与口语),布局原始,和图表类型词汇.
现有评价针对的是人类作者的取舍[34,29]或定量设计-型式差异[17];我们则研究LLMs如何产生这些DSL,同时考虑到语言本身.

blocks.en:
LLMs for Creating Visualization A growing body of work studies LLM-driven chart generation, spanning end-to-end systems [ 7 , 25 , 40 , 41 , 15 ] and natural language
to chart benchmarks [ 20 , 21 , 5 ] .
Some works bypass DSLs entirely by using LLMs to directly generate SVGs [ 32 ] , while chart-QA benchmarks address the dual problem of reading charts [ 48 ] .
Existing authoring benchmarks [ 42 , 5 ] fix a single DSL—such as Vega-Lite or matplotlib—and vary the models and tasks.
Outside visualization, code-generation evaluations [ 2 ] and constrained-decoding work [ 37 ] show that language and schema choices materially shape LLM authoring; we ask the analogous question for visualization, varying the visualization DSL to examine failures as evidence about DSL design itself. Notably, even agentic and code-generation pipelines often emit a declarative JSON specification as their intermediate representation [ 41 , 40 , 12 ] , because specs are validatable, diffable, and safer to execute than arbitrary code—making the design of these DSLs relevant beyond direct authoring.
blocks.zh:
创建可视化LLMS 越来越多的工作研究 LLM 驱动的图表生成,跨越端到端系统 [7, 25, 40, 41, 15] 和自然语言
以图示基准[20、21、5]
一些作品完全通过使用LLMs直接生成SVG[32]来绕过DSL,而图表-QA基准则解决了读取图表[48]的双重问题.
现有作者基准[42,5]固定一个单一的DSL——如Vega-Lite或matplotlib——并改变模型和任务.
外部可视化,代码生成评价[2]和受限解码工作[37]显示语言和计划选择在物质上塑造了LLM的作者;我们提出类似问题进行可视化,改变可视化DSL来审查失败作为DSL设计本身的证据. 值得注意的是,即使是代理和代码生成管道,也常常发出一种声明式的JSON规格作为其中间代表[41、40、12],因为规格是有效的、可传播的,而且比任意的编码更安全,使这些DSL的设计超出直接作者的范围。

blocks.en: 3 Study Design
blocks.zh: 3 研究设计

blocks.en: In this study (illustrated in \hyperref [fig:teaser]Fig. Where LLMs Fail with Visualization DSLs ), we combine sets of DSLs, tasks, and models into a test suite of trials, evaluated for syntactic and semantic correctness (via LLM-as-judge plus manual review).
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中(在\hyperref [fg:teaser] Fig. Where LLMs Fail with Visualization DSLs 中),我们把几套DSL,任务和模型合并成一套测试套件,通过LLM-as-judge+手动审查来评价综合和语义正确性.

blocks.en:
DSLs .
We started from the 19 DSLs in the “Charting” category of McNutt’s [ 24 ] JSON-style visualization DSL survey, which covers tools for general statistical graphics , plus ZingChart, which the survey files under “Responsive Vis” but which is a general-purpose charting DSL (20 candidates) .
From this initial set, we filtered to those that have a publicly installable runtime (excluding XML Charts [ 47 ] for example), appear to be actively maintained (skipping the XML-based ChartML [ 33 ] ), and render headlessly in our Playwright [ 27 ] browser-automation pipeline without proprietary tooling (forgoing FusionCharts [ 9 ] ).
blocks.zh:
DSLs (英语).
我们从McNutt的[24] JSON式可视化DSL调查的"图"类的19个DSL开始,该调查涵盖一般统计图形的工具,加上ZingChart,该调查文件在"反应维斯"下,但是一个通用的DSL图(20个候选).
从这个初始集开始,我们过滤到那些有可公开安装的运行时间(例如不包括XML图 [47]),看起来被积极维护(吸取了基于XML的ChartML [33]),并在我们的Playwright [27]浏览器自定义管道中无自有性地使没有专有工具的浏览器自定义程序(fusionCharts [9]).

blocks.en:
This yielded the following DSLs: Vega-Lite [ 35 ] , Vega [ 36 ] , ECharts [ 19 ] ,
Plotly JSON [ 28 ] , Highcharts [ 14 ] , Chart.js [ 3 ] , ApexCharts [ 1 ] , ZingChart [ 49 ] , and Frappe [ 8 ] .
We also include a recent ChartML project [ 4 ] , distinct from
the ChartML listed in McNutt’s survey, as an actively maintained model-familiarity baseline, for a final set of 10 grammars.
blocks.zh:
由此产生了以下DSL: Vega-Lite [35], Vega [36],ECharts [19],
平面图 JSON [28],高图 [14],图.js [3],顶图 [1],"正图" [49],和"弗拉佩" [8].
我们还包括最近一个图ML项目[4],与
马克努特调查中列出的ChartML,作为积极维护的模型法则基线,用于最终的10个语法.

blocks.en:
Tasks and Synthetic Data .
We use the generation of specific charts as our tasks, using an existing chart taxonomy as a basis, namely Data Viz Catalogue [ 31 ] , for its
extensive scope and practical content (compared to collections such as Xenographics [ 22 ] ).
We then filtered out cases that would mainly test custom icons, freeform drawing, or bespoke layout algorithms rather than chart-spec writing. For instance, brainstorm or mind-map diagrams, word clouds, and Venn diagrams were excluded.
We then manually augmented the task set with cases useful for probing DSL behavior. These included composite tasks such as bar-line combinations, dual axes, reference lines, faceted views, and repeated small multiples, among others.
Each task pairs a target chart type, plus additional constraints such as a required title, color mapping, field choice, legend, axis range, ordering rule, or explicit instruction not to use a decoy field. This design lets us test whether models preserve the requested data and presentation semantics, rather than only producing a plausible chart of the right general type.
blocks.zh:
任务和合成数据 。
我们利用生成具体的图表作为我们的任务,以现有的图表分类法为基础,即数据维兹目录[31]。
(与Xenographics[22]等文献相比)
然后,我们筛选出一些案例,这些案例将主要测试自定义图标,自由格式绘图,或标出布局算法,而不是图表谱写。 例如,脑暴或心智图、字云和文能图被排除在外。
然后我们手动扩充了任务设置, 增加了一些可用于检测DSL行为的案例。 其中包括条线组合,双轴等复合任务,参考线,面相取景等复合任务,再重复小相取相等复合任务.
每个任务配对一个目标图表类型,加上额外的限制,如要求的标题,色彩映射,字段选择,图例,轴范围,命令规则,或者明确指示不要使用诱饵字段. 这一设计让我们检验模型是否保留了所要求的数据和演示语义,而不是仅仅产生一个合理的普通类型的图表。

blocks.en:
Pilot runs showed that models handled simple prompts (e.g., “ a bar chart of sales revenue ”) very well.
To probe the boundaries of model capabilities, we used tasks with explicit, verifiable constraints while keeping prompts expressible in ordinary natural language.
blocks.zh:
试点运行表明,模型处理的简单提示(例如“销售收入条形图”)非常好。
为了探究模型能力的界限,我们利用了具有明确,可核查的制约的任务,同时保持了普通自然语言中可以表达的提示.

blocks.en:
To avoid overlap with LLM training data, each task uses a distinct synthetic compact ( < 10 <10 columns; 5–365 rows, median 16 ) tabular dataset with LLM-generated semantically plausible field names , following similar strategies in prior visualization benchmarks [ 5 , 42 ] .
We also included a small number of irrelevant noise fields which test whether the model selects the intended fields rather than nearby decoys.
blocks.zh:
为了避免与LLM培训数据相重叠,每项任务都采用不同的合成收缩( < 10 < 10列;5-365行,中位数16)表格数据集,并采用LLM生成的精密可信字段名称,遵循先前可视化基准中的类似策略[5,42].
我们还包括了少数无关的噪音场,测试模型是否选择了预定的场而不是附近的诱饵.

blocks.en:
Models .
We ran each task-DSL pair with three models: Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5, and Qwen 3.5 Plus, selected to span different providers and capability tiers (two closed-source, one open-source) and test whether observed patterns are consistent across model families.
blocks.zh:
模特儿们
我们用三种模式运行每个任务-DSL配对:双子3.1 Pro,GPT-5和Quen 3.5 Plus,它们被选定跨越不同的提供者和能力级别(两个闭源,一个开源),并测试所观察到的模式在模型家族之间是否一致.

blocks.en:
Test suite .
The final test suite contains tasks × DSLs × models = 41 × 10 × 3 = 1230 \textrm{tasks}\times\textrm{DSLs}\times\textrm{models}=41\times 10\times 3=1230 trials, giving the task–DSL–model matrix shown in \hyperref [fig:teaser]Fig. Where LLMs Fail with Visualization DSLs .
We do not view this test suite as a leaderboard for either models or DSLs , nor do we claim to compare the design superiority of one DSL over another ; instead it is merely an instrument to interrogate the space of possible issues that LLMs can encounter with visualization DSLs. If LLMs exhibit different error patterns across DSL designs while other factors remain constant, we can reasonably infer that the errors correlate with specific design choices. The full test suite (including all Tasks T1 – T41 ) and experiment results are available in our \href https://llmgrammar.netlify.app interactive supplement . They can also be found in a \href https://github.com/hconhisway/Where-LLM-Fails-Supp github repository .
blocks.zh:
测试套房。
最终的测试套件包含任务×DSLs×型号=41×10×3 =1230\textrm\textrm\textrm\dsLs\textrm\textrm\texts\texters\texts\texters\textext-10\texts 10\texts 3=1230试验,给出了任务-DSL-模型矩阵,以\hyperref [f:teaser]Fig来显示. Where LLMs fail with可视化DSLs.
我们不认为这个测试套件是模型或DSLs的领跑板,我们也不声称比较一个DSL在设计上优于另一个;相反,它仅仅是一种仪器,用来询问LLMs在可视化DSL中可能遇到的问题的空间. 如果LLMS在DSL设计中表现出不同的出错模式而其他因素保持不变,我们可以合理地推断出这些出错与具体的设计选择相关. 我们的\href https://llmgrammar.netlify.app 交互式补充中可以找到完整的测试套件(包括所有 Tasks T1 – T41)和实验结果。 它们也可以在\href https://github.com/hconhisway/Where-LLM-Fails-Supp github仓库中找到。

blocks.en:
The evaluation of this test suite has two stages, as in \hyperref [fig:teaser]Fig. Where LLMs Fail with Visualization DSLs center.
Following prior work [ 5 , 42 ] , the pipeline checks whether the model output can be parsed as JSON and whether the resulting specification can render an image.
Second, rendered cases are evaluated with an 11-item rubric grouped into four axes: structure , encoding , fidelity , and style/readability . Each rubric item is scored as pass or fail; a case “passes all rubric items” only when every item is satisfied. The rubric is more fine-grained than a single quality score because our goal is to study how JSON-based visualization specifications fail.
We developed the rubric through pilot results and iterative discussion among the authors.
Crucially, we treat the scores as diagnostic rather than evaluative: they help locate failures and support cross-case comparison, from which we infer recurring patterns, instead of providing model or DSL rankings.
blocks.zh:
这个测试套件的评价有两个阶段,如\hyperref [fig:teaser] Fig. Where LLMs Fail with可视化DSLs中心.
在前作[5,42]后,管线检查模型输出是否能够被解析为JSON,以及由此产生的规格是否能够渲染出一个图像.
第二,用一个11个项目的标题对案件进行评估,分为四个轴:结构、编码、忠诚和风格/可读性。 每个标题项目被评为通过或失败;一个大小写“所有标题项目”只有在每个项目都满足时才能通过。 我们的目标是研究JSON的可视化规格如何失败。
我们通过试点成果和作者之间的迭接性讨论制定了这个主题。
关键是,我们把分数视为诊断而不是评价:它们有助于查找失败,支持跨例比较,我们从中推断出反复出现的模式,而不是提供模型或DSL排名.

blocks.en:
Following recent work on LLMs and VLMs as judges [ 18 , 26 ] ,
we used a vision-language model, Claude Opus 4.7 , to evaluate the rubric and task requirements for each rendered image.
A human reviewer, the first author, then manually reviewed and audited the model scores and the generated notes about the failures.
Reported rubric numbers use the post-audit results ; when a case was reviewed more than once, we use its most recent review .
We then grouped failures and iteratively identified recurring error patterns across DSLs, chart types, and models.
blocks.zh:
继最近关于法学硕士和法学硕士作为法官的工作之后[18、26],
我们用一种视觉语言模型 Claude Opus 4.7 来评价每个图像的标点和任务要求。
人类评论员,第一作者,然后手动审查和审核模型分数和生成的关于失败的注释.
上报的编号使用审计后的结果;
然后,我们将失败和反复识别的反复出现的错误模式分组到DSL、图表类型和模型中。

blocks.en:
Limitations .
This experiment has a deliberately narrow scope, and the results should be read with several limitations in mind.
First, our goal is to evaluate factors in DSL design that lead to model usage failures,
rather than evaluate individual model performance.
We also do not cover the full problem of natural-language-to-visualization using LLMs—which has been studied in depth [ 21 ] —instead focusing solely on the relationship between DSL design and error forms.
Second, the results of our experiment may be affected by prompt engineering—giving the model documentation files, examples, or a BNF grammar description would likely improve some results [ 39 ] .
Adding those conditions would also make the study much more complex, so we use a single, simple prompting style throughout. Our zero-shot design is intentional: it measures each model’s internalized representation of a DSL—the baseline that documentation, RAG, or grammar-prompting builds upon. Adding documentation would confound DSL design effects with documentation quality, obscuring the signal we aim to study. Next, our experiment does not engage with the context or environment in which a chart is created; we assume the errors are at the same level of abstraction as the DSLs, allowing findings to transfer.
Finally, we did not run repeated trials for each case. The evaluation pipeline requires extensive, laborious human supervision and post-audit review, which would make the additional trials infeasible to review. More broadly, prompt style, synthetic data generation, and model selection are all potential confounders. We control for these by holding each factor constant while varying the DSL, but we do not claim to isolate DSL design as the sole cause of failure. The design considerations we propose are best read as empirically grounded directions that await validation in further studies with broader model sets, prompting strategies, and task distributions.
blocks.zh:
限制 .
这一实验有刻意缩小范围,在阅读结果时应铭记若干局限性.
首先,我们的目标是评估DSL设计中导致模型使用失败的因素,
而不是评价个别模式的业绩。
我们还没有涵盖使用LLMS进行自然语言到可视化的全部问题——这个问题已经深入研究过[21]——而只侧重于DSL设计和出错表之间的关系。
第二,我们实验的结果可能会受到迅速工程的影响——提供示范文献文件、实例或BNF语法描述可能会改进一些结果[39]。
增加这些条件也会使研究变得更加复杂,因此我们在整个过程中使用单一的,简单的提示风格. 我们的零射出设计是有意的:它衡量每个模型内化的DSL的表示,即文件、RAG或语法促动的基础。 添加文件将使DSL的设计效果与文件质量相混淆,模糊我们打算研究的信号. 接下来,我们的实验不接触创建图表的背景或环境;我们假设错误处于与DSLs相同的抽象水平,允许结果传输.
最后,我们没有重复审理每个案件。 评估程序要求进行广泛、艰苦的人力监督和审计后审查,这将使额外审判无法进行审查。 更广泛地说,即时风格、合成数据生成和模型选择都是潜在的混淆者。 我们通过在改变DSL的同时保持每个因子常数来控制这些,但我们并不声称孤立DSL设计是失败的唯一原因. 我们提出的设计考虑,最好被理解为以经验为基础的方向,这些方向有待在使用更广泛的模型集的进一步研究中加以验证,推动战略和任务分配。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
Of the 1230 trials, 7 (all Gemini) failed to return a result due to recurring generation errors, leaving 1223 generated specifications.
Each stage only receives the cases that passed the previous one.
1222 trials (99.3% of 1230) passed JSON validation, and 964 (78.4% of 1230) rendered an image; all 123 ChartML outputs were valid JSON, but none rendered.
Only the 964 rendered cases were rubric-reviewed: 416 of them (43.2% of rendered cases; 33.8% of all 1230 trials) passed all 11 rubric items (GPT-5: 117/312; Qwen: 127/308; Gemini: 172/344), and the remaining 548 (56.8% of rendered cases) failed at least one item. A per-DSL and per-model breakdown of these counts is available in the interactive supplement. These numbers should be read as a description of the data generated for qualitative analysis and not as a fair comparison among DSLs or models.
Because some DSLs have broader vocabularies, some tasks intentionally target difficult chart families, and ChartML was included partly to test what happens when an actively maintained schema is still unfamiliar to current models.

只有964起已审案件经过重审:其中416起(占已审案件的43.2%;占所有1230起审判的33.8%)通过了所有11起重案(GPT-5:117/312;Quen:127/308;双子座:172/344),而其余548起(占已审案件的56.8%)至少未能完成一起。 互动补编载有这些统计的每个DSL和每个模型的分类。 这些数字应被理解为对生成的数据进行定性分析的一种描述,而不是对DSL或模型的公平比较。
由于一些DSL有更宽的词汇,一些任务故意以困难的图表家族为目标,而ChartML被包括进来,部分是为了测试当一个积极维护的策略仍然不熟悉当前模型时会发生什么.

blocks.en:
After the rubric review, the first author coded the failures and grouped them into themes via affinity diagramming.
These themes capture how prompt requirements, model behavior, and language design together led to incorrect charts, providing initial evidence about where LLM specification-writing becomes brittle.
blocks.zh:
在标题审查后,第一位作者对失败进行了编码,并通过亲和图将失败归为主题.
这些主题捕捉了快速要求,模型行为,以及语言设计如何共同导致图表不正确,提供了LLM规格-写作在哪里变得简洁的初步证据.

blocks.en:
Encoding Mismatch .
The first error cluster occurred when models used the right data field in the wrong encoding location.
This happened most often when a DSL did not expose position, value, color, and legend as independent encoding channels (i.e., named properties that map a data column to a visual attribute) , as in Chart.js’s polarArea , where labels, values, and colors are distributed across chart-specific arrays.
The output could then look plausible, and even potentially render successfully, while still mis-using a field as a dataset name, node label, color array, or internal trace value rather than as the requested encoding channel ( \hyperref [fig:case1]Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
编码错误 。
第一个出错集群发生在模型在错误的编码位置使用正确的数据字段时.
最常发生这种情况的是,DSL没有将位置、价值、颜色和传说暴露为独立的编码通道(即将数据列映射到可视属性的命名属性),如Chart.js的极地,标记、价值和颜色分布在图表特定数组中。
然后,输出看起来是可信的,甚至有可能成功渲染,同时仍然错误地使用一个字段作为数据集名称,节点标签,颜色阵列,或内部微量值,而不是作为所请求的编码通道(\hyperref [fg:case1] Fig. 1).

blocks.en:
Crucially, the issue is not merely placement of an invalid key.
Instead, it is that the syntax complects visualization semantics with a chart-specific data shape.
For example, on Gemini’s Chart.js pass of T24 : the input table has one row per month-channel pair, with fields for month, donation amount, and channel name. The prompt asks for a rose chart with months around the angle, donation_amount as the radius, and channel_name as color and legend.
Ostensibly, this should be a simple field mapping: month controls position, donation amount controls radius, and channel name controls color.
However, Chart.js’s polarArea does not expose those roles as independent encodings.
Instead, category labels, legend entries, values, and colors are inferred from the chart-specific arrangement of data.labels , datasets , and backgroundColor .
The generated spec in \hyperref [fig:case1]Fig. 1 follows a plausible series-based layout by placing months in data.labels and channels in datasets[i].label . For polarArea , that container position has the wrong semantics: data.labels defines the wedge/default-legend categories, while datasets[i].label names a dataset rather than a per-wedge color category.
The scalar backgroundColor on each dataset likewise colors a whole dataset, not each row. Thus the output is valid JSON, but the encoding is not as requested.
blocks.zh:
重要的是,问题不仅仅是放置无效钥匙。
取而代之的是语法将可视化语义与图表所特有的数据形状相通.
例如,在双子座图上.js pass of T24:输入表有一行每月一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一行一一行一行一一行一一行一行一一行一行一行一行一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一 提示请求以相角相绕数月为玫瑰图,以捐赠_amount为半径,以频道_名称为颜色和传说.
可以说,这应该是简单的场地映射:月份控制位置,捐赠金额控制半径,以及通道名称控制颜色.
然而,图.js的极地 区域不会将这些角色暴露为独立的编码.
相反,分类标签、图例条目、数值和颜色是从数据的图表特定安排推断出来的。
在\hyperref [图: case1] Fig. 1 中生成的光谱, 遵循了一种基于逻辑序列的布局, 在数据中放置了数月. labels and channels in data sets[i]. label 。 对于极地,该容器位置有错误的语义:data.labels定义了wedge/default-legend类,而数据集[i].label则命名了一个数据集,而不是一对对接的颜色类.
每个数据集的平面背景Color同样给一个完整的数据集取色,而不是每行. 因此,输出是有效的JSON,但编码不符合要求.

Channel names placed in datasets[i].label do not become wedge colors; the repair flattens month-channel rows and assigns color per wedge.

blocks.en:
The same entanglement appears in simpler cases.
In GPT-5’s ApexCharts T1 , the model stores risk_band inside each data object and sets customLegendItems —plausible locations, but ApexCharts does not treat them as field-level color encodings. Without plotOptions.bar.distributed:true , bars take the first color rather than varying by category, and the custom labels do not produce a categorical legend. The category is present in the JSON, but not in the DSL location that controls mark color or legend entries.
blocks.zh:
同样的缠绕出现在更简单的案例中.
在GPT-5的Apex Charts T1中,模型在每个数据对象中存储了风险-波段并设置自定义 图例项目 — 可信位置, 但 Apex Charts 不把它们当作字段级的颜色编码 。 没有图案可选. bar. diversed: true , 栏取出第一个颜色而不是按类别变化, 自定义标签不会产生一个绝对的传说. 该分类存在于JSON中,但不存在于控制标记颜色或图例条目的DSL位置.

blocks.en: The observed failures suggest that models are less reliable at translating semantic fields into chart-specific container structures than at filling consistently placed encoding slots, especially when a container position carries different semantics across chart types—echoing McNutt [ 24 ] this is also likely an issue for humans.
blocks.zh: 观测到的失败表明,模型在将语义字段转换成图表专用的容器结构方面不如在装入一致放置的编码槽方面更可靠,特别是当容器位置在图表类型上携带不同的语义时——选择McNutt[24],这对人类来说也是个问题。

blocks.en:
DSLs may be easier for LLMs when common encodings are expressed at the field or channel level.
Color, legend entries, sort order, and axis titles seem more robust when they can be written as field references, rather than indirectly through the number and names of datasets or series—echoing Cognitive Dimensions of Notation (CDN) [ 11 ] , stronger consistency seems to lead to better performance for humans and models.
This does not suggest that series-based APIs are unusable, only that this approach has a greater risk of errors. Design Consideration
blocks.zh:
当普通编码在字段或通道级别被表达时,DSL可能对LLMS更容易.
色彩,传说条目,排序顺序,和轴标题,当可以被写作为字段参考时,而不是通过数据集或系列的数量和名称间接地——选取标记的认知维度(CDN)[11],更强的一致性似乎可以导致人类和模型更好的性能.
这并不意味着基于系列的API是无法使用的,只是这种方法有更大的出错风险. 设计考虑

blocks.en:
Layout Arithmetic Failure . Next are instances where the model failed to coordinate spacing, sizing, margins, or panel geometry.
Besides the data encodings, a range of other features—including multi-panel layout, legends, axis labels, rotated ticks, and titles—all compete for space.
blocks.zh:
算术失败 。 其次是模型未能协调间隔、大小、边距或面板几何的情况。
除了数据编码之外,一系列其他特性——包括多板块布局,传说,轴标签,旋转的勾和标题——都争夺空间.

blocks.en:
Plotly’s GPT-5 T7 illustrates this well: the title, horizontal legend, and top margin are three separate settings.
The rendered legend collides with the title because the model puts the legend above the plot but does not allocate enough space for both.
blocks.zh:
Plotly的GPT-5 T7很好地说明了这一点:标题,水平传奇,和上边是三个独立的设置.
被渲染的传说与标题相撞,因为模型将传说置于情节之上,但没有为两者分配足够的空间.

blocks.en:
We saw similar layout pressure in larger compositions.
Vega-Lite facets can overflow the capture frame when the model does not size the cells for a dense grid.
Vega group layouts can clip panels or shared legends when the model writes per-panel widths without budgeting for outer labels.
Plotly subplot grids require row spacing, column spacing, trace routing, and panel titles to be coordinated separately.
These are all slightly different failures, but they share the same basic form: the DSL allows expression of the layout, but it also necessitates several coordinated layout decisions that only become legible after rendering—echoing a similar difficulty in annotations [ 30 ] . Our results suggest that LLMs may struggle with fine-grained spatial layout decisions, particularly when the correctness of those decisions can only be verified after rendering. This suggests that models are better at declaring compositional intent, such as “facet by region” or “place the legend below,” than at solving the low-level geometry that some DSLs expose as parameters.
blocks.zh:
我们在更大的成分中看到了类似的布局压力.
Vega-Lite侧面可以在模型不为密集网格大小的细胞时溢出捕获框.
Vega组的布局可以剪接面板或共享传说,当模型写出每平面宽度而不为外标签编制预算时.
Plotly子plot网格要求行间距,列间距,微分路由,和面板标题分别协调.
这些都是略有不同的失败,但它们都具有相同的基本形式:DSL允许表达布局,但同时也需要几个协调的布局决定,这些决定只有在渲染后才能被辨别出——在注释中选择类似的困难[30]. 我们的结果表明,有限责任公司可能难以作出精细的空间布局决定,特别是当这些决定的正确性只能在作出之后才能加以核实时。 这表明,模型比解决一些DSL作为参数所暴露的低等几何特征要好于宣布构成意图,例如“逐个区域的面”或“将传说置于下面”。

blocks.en:
Layout primitives may help if they declaratively allocate space, rather than requiring navigation of multiple implicit constraints. An operator like facet can still expose advanced overrides, but the default path should allocate room for axis labels, titles, panel labels, and shared legends.
This shifts the model toward declaring structure rather than solving pixel arithmetic—a principle that also supports human usage in GoG-style designs [ 35 ] . Design Consideration
blocks.zh:
如果布局原始人公开地分配空间,而不是要求导航多重隐含的制约,那么布局原始人可能会有所帮助. 像facet这样的操作员仍然可以曝光高级的覆盖,但默认路径应该为轴标签,标题,面板标签,以及共享的传说分配空间.
这让模型向宣布结构而不是解析像素算术——这一原则也支持人类在GOG式设计中的用法[35]. 设计考虑

blocks.en:
Missed Renderer Defaults . We observed failures related to omitted settings or missed renderer conventions that fundamentally changed the chart.
Many errors were not caused by malformed JSON or by choosing the wrong input fields, but instead came from contracts that sit outside the visible part of the generated spec.
For instance, defaults that engage only when a property is omitted, data shapes that are accepted but interpreted differently from what was intended, strict object forms that silently drop near-misses, and chart-type names whose semantics differ across libraries.
blocks.zh:
失明的伦德 默认。 我们看到与省略的设置有关的失败,或者忽略了根本改变图表的渲染器常规。
许多错误不是由错误的JSON或选择错误的输入字段所造成,而是来自位于生成的光谱的可见部分以外的合同.
例如,只有在一个属性被省略时才涉及的缺省、被接受但解释与原意不同的数据形状、静悄悄地掉入近漏的严格对象形式以及不同库中语义不同的图表类型名称。

blocks.en:
A clear default-driven example is shown in \hyperref [fig:case2]Fig. 2 .
In GPT-5’s Vega-Lite T6 , the prompt asks for a daily ferry boarding line chart from Monday through Sunday.
The generated spec chooses the right fields, placing day_label on the x-axis and boarding_count on the y-axis, and it uses the requested blue line.
At the level of field selection, this looks correct. The failure comes from the ordering contract attached to the x channel: day_label is declared as ordinal, but the spec does not provide an explicit sort .
Vega-Lite then orders the weekday strings alphabetically, yielding days incorrectly sequenced Fri, Mon, Sat, Sun, Thu, Tue, Wed.
blocks.zh:
以\hyperref [图: case2] 图2 显示一个明显的默认驱动实例 。
在GPT-5的Vega-Lite T6中,
生成的 spec 选择正确的字段,在 x- 轴上放置 day_ label 在 y- 轴上设置 登入_ 计数,它使用请求的蓝线.
就实地选择而言,这似乎是正确的。 失败来自x 频道所附的订单合同: 日_ label 被宣布为正文, 但 spec没有提供明确的排序 。
Vega-Lite然后按字母顺序命令工作日的弦,产生错序的弗里,蒙, 萨特, 孙 图,图,韦德.

blocks.en: Figure 2: GPT-5’s Vega-Lite T6 output uses the correct fields for a daily ferry boarding line chart, but omits the weekday order, yielding alphabetized labels.
blocks.zh: 图2:GPT-5的Vega-Lite T6输出使用正确的字段进行每日渡口登船行图,但省略了周令,产生字母化的标签.

blocks.en:
Defaults can add visible content not requested in the task. For instance, GPT-5’s ApexCharts T12 percentage labels appear inside a donut chart because dataLabels.enabled is set to true. This is not a syntax error, and the chart is recognizable, but the output contains an extra annotation layer relative to the prompt.
Whereas towers of defaults are crucial to the usability of DSLs for humans (à la the design of ggplot2 [ 44 ] and Vega-Lite [ 35 ] ), this extra implied information can trip up or complicate LLM’s DSL use.
blocks.zh:
默认可以添加任务中未请求的可见内容. 例如,GPT-5的顶级图 T12 百分比标签出现在甜甜圈图中,因为数据标签。 启用为真。 这不是一个语法错误,图表是可识别的,但输出中包含一个相对于快报的额外注释层.
虽然默认的塔楼对于DSL的人类可用性至关重要(对于ggplot2[44]和Vega-Lite[35]的设计),但这种额外的隐含信息可能会使LLM的DSL使用出错或复杂化.

blocks.en:
Renderers could make more of their hidden behavior visible. A resolved-spec view could show which defaults fired after the first render. Clear parse-time errors could replace silent drops for ignored keys, malformed values, or unsupported data arrangements. Similar chart types could use names and data contracts that are less easy to confuse across libraries.
These changes would not reduce expressiveness but would make the DSL more legible to models and, as documentation, to humans. Design Consideration
blocks.zh:
渲染者可以让更多的隐性行为可见. 解析- spec 视图可以显示在第一次渲染后发射的默认值 。 清除剖析时间错误可以替换被忽略的密钥,错误的值,或者不支持的数据安排的静音滴. 类似的图表类型可以使用名称和数据合同,这些名称和数据合同在图书馆之间不太容易混淆。
这些变化不会降低表达性,而会使DSL更清晰地被模型所辨识出,并且作为文献,被人类所辨识出. 设计考虑

These changes would not reduce expressiveness but would make the DSL more legible to models and, as documentation, to humans.
blocks.zh:
渲染者可以让更多的隐性行为可见. 解析- spec 视图可以显示在第一次渲染后发射的默认值 。 清除剖析时间错误可以替换被忽略的密钥,错误的值,或者不支持的数据安排的静音滴. 类似的图表类型可以使用名称和数据合同,这些名称和数据合同在图书馆之间不太容易混淆。
这些变化不会降低表达性,而会使DSL更清晰地被模型所辨识出,并且作为文献,被人类所辨识出.

blocks.en:
Failed Workaround . Lastly were failures where the model used a substitute chart or hand-built workaround that did not preserve the requested semantics.
LLMs tend to return something in response to any request, typically by selecting a nearby primitive or composing lower-level marks.
These attempts are informative because they show which path through the DSL seemed available to the model. For instance, on GPT-5’s Vega-Lite T19 , the model tries to build a radar chart by layering line and area marks in polar coordinates. The strategy is recognizable, but it does not match Vega-Lite’s mark vocabulary: theta and radius are not general polar-position channels for line and area marks.
The chart therefore renders the title and team legend but almost no radar geometry, collapsing the requested three polygons to an essentially empty plot.
Similarly, on GPT-5’s Plotly T29 , the model tries to approximate a streamgraph with ordinary stacked area traces using stackgroup .
That recovers the layered area appearance, but fails the defining streamgraph property: the layers are not arranged around a centered baseline.
blocks.zh:
工作失败了。 最后是失败,即该模型使用了替代图表或手工制造的不保留所请求的语义的工作。
LLMS倾向于响应任何请求而还原某种东西,一般通过选择附近的原始或编组下等分.
这些尝试是翔实的,因为它们显示了该模型似乎可以利用的DSL路径。 例如,在GPT-5的Vega-Lite T19上,该模型试图通过分层线和极地坐标的区域标记来绘制雷达图。 策略是可识别的,但与Vega-Lite的标记词汇不相匹配:"Theta"和"半径"不是线和地区标记的一般极地位置通道.
因此,该图使得标题和团队传奇,但几乎没有雷达几何,使请求的三个多边形倒塌为一个基本上为空的地块.
同样,在GPT-5的平面图T29上,该模型试图用堆放组来取近似于普通堆放区域痕迹的流图。
这恢复了分层区域外观,但未能实现定义流图属性:分层不是围绕一个中心基线排列的.

blocks.en:
Not all workarounds fail. For instance, Chart.js has no first-class facet primitive, but on Gemini’s Chart.js T37 , the model still produces a usable faceted bar chart ( \hyperref [fig:chartjs-t37]Fig. 4 ) by flattening the panels into one bar chart.
Each x-axis label combines the district and priority, and null data values create visual gaps between district groups, yielding a makeshift small-multiples.
blocks.zh:
并不是所有的工作都失败了。 例如,Chart.js没有一等的面相原始,但是在双子座的Chart.js T37上,该模型仍然通过将面相板平整成一列条形图(\hyperref [fg:chartjs-t37] Fig. 4)来制作一个可用的面相条形图.
每个x轴标签结合了区和优先级,无效的数据值在区组之间产生可视性差距,产生一个临时的"小多".

blocks.en:
While the failures above were about the wrong workaround, ChartML’s failures are about not knowing the DSL in the first place.
All 41 cases fail for every model with the same parser error, because the models simply do not know this syntax.
ChartML is recent and has little public presence, so none of the three models had learned its syntax, which is not supplied in the prompt.
With nothing to go on, each model defaults to the nearest DSL it does know—Vega-Lite-shaped specs from Gemini and Qwen, a Highcharts-style {chart: {...}} wrapper from many GPT-5 outputs—none of which match ChartML’s actual top-level shape ( type: chart , data , visualize ), so the spec is rejected before any design choice in ChartML can be investigated. ChartML controls for unfamiliarity: despite its 100% parse-failure rate, all four patterns persist in familiar DSLs. This, unsurprisingly, confirms that adoption and public examples are a prerequisite for LLM authoring without documentation augmentation.
blocks.zh:
ChartML的失败首先在于不了解DSL。
所有41个模型都失败了,因为模型根本不知道这个语法。
ChartML是近代的,几乎没有公开存在,所以这三种模型都没有学过它的语法,它并没有在即时提供.
无事可做,每个模型默认到它知道的最接近的DSL——从双子座和Quen的Vega-Lite-形状的光谱,一个Highcharts-style {chart:{.}来自许多GPT-5输出的包装-其中没有一个匹配ChartML的实际顶级形状(类型:图表,数据,可视化),因此在ChartML中的任何设计选择都可以被调查之前,光谱被否决了. 图表 对不熟悉的 ML 控制: 尽管它百分之百的解析失败率,但所有四种模式都存在于熟悉的DSL中. 这不足为奇,证明收养和公开的事例是无需文件扩充而编写LLM的先决条件。

blocks.en:
Support for less common chart types does not always require a separate named primitive for every chart type. It may be just as important to provide a small set of composition tools that behave predictably.
Named primitives are useful when the model knows what inputs they expect. But when the DSL does not include the requested chart directly, the model needs a reliable way to assemble it from simpler parts, which is especially critical for less prominent DSLs.
This is notably different than human behavior, where a human would likely give up or switch tools. Design Consideration
blocks.zh:
对不太常见的图表类型的支持并不总是要求每个图表类型都有一个单独的命名原始. 同样重要的是,提供一套可以预测的构成工具。
当模型知道他们期望什么投入时,命名的原始人是有用的. 但是当DSL没有直接包括所请求的图表时,模型需要从更简单的部分组装出一个可靠的方法,这对不太突出的DSL特别关键.
这与人类的行为明显不同,人类可能放弃或切换工具。 设计考虑

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This work provides a first exploration of how LLMs fail when specifying charts via visualization DSLs, laying groundwork for adapting DSL design to this new class of author. Some of the patterns we identify—such as layout arithmetic failure and missed renderer defaults —reflect challenges that human authors also face, and our design considerations reinforce established principles of well-designed visualization grammars. Other patterns, notably failed workaround , appear to be more LLM-specific: a human author who lacks a chart primitive typically stops or switches tools, whereas an LLM attempts an improvised composition that can silently violate the requested semantics. We suspect that additional properties may be unique to LLMs.
To that end, we note that there may be a collection of notational properties
applicable to LLMs and not humans—echoing CDN [ 11 ] .
For instance, viscosity largely appears to be irrelevant as tedious transforms are relatively straightforward for LLMs, while new properties like Training-set Exposure or Tokenization Alignment (echoing the well known r’s in strawberry) may be salient, and should be investigated in future work.
blocks.zh:
本作首次探索了LLMs在通过可视化DSL来指定图表时如何失败,为将DSL设计适应于这个新类作者奠定了基础. 我们确定的一些模式——如布局算术故障和错失了渲染器默认——反映了人类作者也面临的挑战,我们的设计考虑加强了设计良好的可视化语法的既定原则. 其他模式,特别是失败的工作似乎更适合LLM:缺少原始图表的人类作者通常会停止或交换工具,而LLM则尝试一种可以无声地违反所要求语义的即兴构成。 我们怀疑其他财产可能是LLMS独有的.
为此,我们注意到,可能有一些标记性财产。
适用于LLMs而不是人类——选择CDN[11]。
例如,粘度似乎基本上无关紧要,因为对于LLMS来说,乏味的转变相对来说是直截了当的,而诸如Train-set Expose或Tokenization unitation(在草莓中选择众所周知的r)等新属性可能是突出的,应该在今后的工作中加以调查。
